title: context.window body v1
description: Window/workspace events. Publisher: jv-context (compositor event stream — no polling). Titles are redacted (null + redacted=true) for blocklisted app_ids: password managers and private surfaces ship pre-seeded in the config. Envelope conf = 1.0.

kind.description: What happened. focus_changed frames define 'this'/'the active window' for jv-act resolution.

window_id.description: Compositor window id — stable for the window's lifetime; the handle jv-act targets.

app_id.description: Wayland app_id (e.g. 'firefox'). Empty string if the compositor doesn't know.

title.description: Window title, or null when unavailable or redacted (see `redacted`).

workspace.description: Workspace/output-space name if the compositor reports one.

focused.description: Whether this window has focus after the event.

redacted.description: True when the title was withheld by the privacy blocklist.
